svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.ukraine-flag-layout-context", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One introduced Ukraine national-flag layout: 2 equal horizontal bands, blue/yellow from top to bottom, height:length 2:3. Frame [150, 100]mm on [190, 140]mm page. Boundaries convey equal regions;colour andidentity depend on the external key. Accessible teacher/audio key introduces ukraine,orientation horizontal top to bottom,colour roles blue, yellow. Height:length 2:3, supported by indexed parliamentary Resolution 2067-XII and Ukrainian Institute of National Memory guidance. Direct parliamentary reader returned 403; no full original template read claimed. Country and colour roles require an accessible teacher/audio key. Native grey fills do not intrinsically encode hue; independent ratio-based layout, not exact original template reproduction. Plain two-band national flag, not an embellished presidential or military standard.", "native_tip_geometry": null, "native_curve_parameters": null, "geometry_exception": "Index native1.2mm outline samples with3.1mm guard;declared boundary/frame contacts coalesce. Compatible continuous band-boundary paths shared between Swell/ViewPlus. No medium geometry exception beyond native sampling. Colour/identity introduced byexternal accessible key.", "band_regions": [{"id": "band-1", "colour_role": "blue", "rectangle_mm": [20, 20.0, 150, 50.0]}, {"id": "band-2", "colour_role": "yellow", "rectangle_mm": [20, 70.0, 150, 50.0]}], "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native outline sampling retains declared logicalboundary/frame contacts. 1.2mm native line samples;3.1mm minimum centre guard;logicalpartcontactsshare samples;anchors preserved;all additional samples guarded at3.1mm;maximum path step documented;physicalcontinuity andreaderrecognition pending.
